newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bimbo invests $9 mln in plant.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bimbo invests $9 mln in plant.

text.p: Mexican bread giant Grupo Industrial Bimbo (Bimbo) invested $9 million in a new plant that opened Tuesday, chairman Roberto Servitje Sendra said.
The plant in the city of Merida in the southern state of Yucatan had production lines for bread, cakes and tortillas, Mexico's corn flour pancakes, he said.
Bimbo expects to export product from the Merida plant to Florida and Central America, he added.

To date this year, Bimbo has also invested in a new wheat milling plant in the northern state of Nuevo Leon, a corn mill in the central state of Hidalgo and other unspecified projects in Colombia and Florida, the chairman said.
